description.value: Whispering Willows Campsite is a privately operated campground situated along Highway 97 near Williams Lake in the Cariboo region, catering to both tent campers and RV travellers. The site features private campsites set among trees beside a creek, with fire pits and picnic tables throughout. It offers a range of hookup options from un-serviced shaded tent sites to full-service RV pads with power, water, and sewer.

address.value: 4930 BC-97, Williams Lake, BC V2G 5M6, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the business name, phone number (250-989-2311), and website URL. The site describes three campsite types including un-serviced tent sites with fire pits and picnic tables, plus full- and partial-service RV sites with water hookups, and explicitly promotes an online reservation system. No address is present in the OSM record or on the website, and many amenity details (showers, washrooms, laundry, etc.) are not mentioned.
concerns: No physical address available in OSM record or on website — geocoordinates are the only location data.
OSM record has no osm_id and no osm_tags, suggesting this was added manually rather than from an OSM export; data provenance should be verified.
Campground is seasonal (May 1–October 1 per website); directory users should be aware it is closed in winter months.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational campground along a major cycling corridor (Highway 97) with an active website, online reservations, and tent sites — directly useful to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Un-serviced tent sites are shaded and include a fire pit and picnic table — likely the most relevant option for cycle tourists not carrying RV hookup gear.
